title: Wanderer's Dream
description: A relatively simple vanilla plus modpack.
body:
Wanderer's Dream is a relatively simple vanilla plus modpack inspired by Homestead. The core gameplay loop stays relatively the same, just with a few extra bits added here and there. 

I put in some extra effort to focus on the combat in this modpack. I really enjoy first person melee combat, so I did my best to make the first person combat as satisfying as possibke with the very few mods I have at my disposal.

I'm not entirely sure if I'll be adding updates to this modpack, seeing as I only uploaded it so I would never lose it, but maybe if people find it and enjoy it I'll Consider updating it :)
